txt_en: Always remember that you are absolutely unique. Just like everyone else.
txt_cn: 永远记住你是独一无二的，就像其他人一样。
author: Margaret Mead

txt_en: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
txt_cn: 获得朋友的唯一方法是成为别人的朋友。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

txt_en: The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more.
txt_cn: 最好的爱，唤醒我们的灵魂，让我们更有追求。
author: Nicholas Sparks

txt_en: Life is the sum of all your choices.
txt_cn: 你做的所有抉择造就了你的人生。
author: Albert Camus
